judgments.reason: The span 'displaced the epiglottis posteriorly and narrowed the airway' appears literally in the flexible laryngoscopy findings and directly supports airway obstruction as a complication of the base of tongue cyst.
The span 'compressing the oropharyngeal airway and displacing the epiglottis posteriorly' appears literally in the CT findings and clinically supports the obstructing modifier.

The span 'complete pharyngeal airway obstruction during both inspiration and expiration as the mass pulled the epiglottis down and backward' appears literally in the sleep videofluoroscopy findings and strongly supports the obstructing modifier.
